label: Instructional Task 2
stem: Let f be the function that assigns to a temperature in degrees Celsius its equivalent in degrees Fahrenheit. Let g be the function that assigns to a temperature in degrees Kelvin its equivalent in degrees Celsius. Part A. Explain what x and f(g(x)) represent in terms of temperatures, or explain why there is no reasonable representation. Part B. Explain what x and g(f(x)) represent in terms of temperatures, or explain why there is no reasonable representation. Part C. Given that f(x) = 95x + 32 and g(x) = x − 273, find an expression for f(g(x)). Part D. Find an expression for the function h which assigns to a temperature in degrees Fahrenheit its equivalent in degrees Kelvin.
